NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Admissions Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the notification for the PG/ Ph.D Under NTA ICAR AIEEA Admission Entrance Examination 2026. The online application process for NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Admissions Online Form 2026 has started on 08 May 2026, and candidates can apply till 10 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Admissions Online Form 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 May 2026
  • Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • AIEEA PG Course
  • General : Rs. 1300/-
  • OBC, EWS : Rs. 1255/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 675/-
  • AIEEA JRF / SRF (PHd) Courses
  • General : Rs. 2000/-
  • EWS, OBC : Rs. 1955/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1025/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Admissions Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 10 June 2026.

The official website is: https://icar.nta.nic.in/
